_readme: Level 3 review content (T09, Level3ReviewRules). cases: each case's own review clock, ReviewClockDefinition fields as in Level 2 (allowanceSeconds of ACTIVE time, warnSeconds, lateExp = the one punctuality mark inside the case XP cap, lateHearts unused: Public Trust never moves for time). Bea's 16 active minutes start after the protected calculator practice; the company's clock arrives with T11/T12.
Lines may use {minutes} (game minutes left), {time} (active m:ss) and {deadline} (today's cutoff).
auditor: CONTENT 'Review returned' and 'Bea approval' lines; hold / falseHold / staleStamp open his other answers.

roots: what the Auditor says about each case-scoped root (FIXTURE_CONTRACT root keys). They name the line and the Tax Code Book section, never a client value. credit-as-expense is the credit-source note when the credit was used above its own line.
Fields starting with '_' are notes and are ignored by the game.

clock.announceLine: Bea's review is open: {minutes} minutes of review time today. The cutoff is {deadline}.
clock.warnLine: {minutes} minutes of review time left today.
clock.missedLine: Today's review window has closed. Bea's work is kept for tomorrow morning.
clock.nextMorningLine: A new morning: {minutes} minutes of review time. Everything you did is still here.

approved: Approved for this computation review. Give Bea her copy and explain the balance.
auditor.returned: Your work is kept. Start with the line I marked, then check the calculations that depend on it.
auditor.hold: Thank you for holding it. Something on the sheet is still open, so it stays with you.
auditor.falseHold: You held this computation, but I can't find an open problem on it.
auditor.staleStamp: Your stamp is older than this sheet. Something changed after you stamped it.

roots.note: Gross income comes from the checked worksheet's Income subtotal (Tax Code Book, Section 6).
Allowable expenses come from the checked worksheet's subtotal, not the draft claims (Sections 4 and 5).
Taxable income is gross income minus allowable expenses, from the two lines above (Section 6).
The rate band is the row of the annual table that holds the taxable income (Section 7).
Tax due is the band's base tax plus its rate on the excess over the floor only (Section 8).
Tax credits are the tax withheld on Bea's own certificate for this year (Section 9).
The withholding credit was taken off before the tax: it comes off the tax due at the end (Section 9).
The remaining payable is tax due minus tax credits (Section 9).
Stamp the sheet as it is now, then bring it back.
Every line is supported: a hold needs an open problem. Stamp it Ready for computation review.
